entries.zh: 才学低劣、所知甚少（劣才）；懂得很少
entries.en: to know little; to be of poor, mean talent
entries.notes: M 栏圈注三连读、尾词残损（munogf…，另含 T99 声调污损），据主读 loar chay（劣才）与西语 Saber poco 定义

entries.zh: 略懂、稍通；懂得不多
entries.en: to know a little; to be slightly versed
entries.notes: H「語」与音写「am」不合，疑为「諳」（通晓）之异写；按西语 Saber poco 义定为略懂

entries.zh: 略识、懂得一点；所知有限
entries.en: to know a little; to have some knowledge

entries.zh: 识路、认得道；知道有哪些路可走
entries.en: to know the way; to know which roads there are

entries.zh: 见识；多见多闻、阅历广博（什么都知道过）
entries.en: breadth of experience; to know much, to have seen it all
entries.notes: M 栏首音后残损且含 T99（guin [残]; guin fit 与汉字「識」音不合），据西语 Saber mucho, saber haverlo todo 与汉字「見識」定义

entries.zh: 会做工、能劳作；有一门手艺
entries.en: to know how to work; to be skilled at a trade
entries.notes: 汉字「曲節」与「做工」字面关联不明，按西语 Saber trabajar（17 世纪马尼拉 Sangley 匠人语境）义定为会做工

entries.zh: 识尊卑；知道对各人按其身份给以当得的敬重
entries.en: to know how to honor each one as he deserves; to know due rank and respect

entries.zh: 半知半解；知道一点
entries.en: to know something of it; to half-know

entries.zh: 有本事；会办事、会经营生意
entries.en: to be capable; to know how to manage affairs and trade

entries.zh: 会做生意、善于经营谋划
entries.en: to know how to trade and negotiate; to plan shrewdly
entries.notes: 汉字「絲綸」本义丝缕／帝王诏令，与 Saber negociar 对应不明；按西语 17 世纪义（经商、斡旋）定义

entries.zh: 有经纶、会办事；善于治事理物
entries.en: to know how to conduct and manage affairs; statecraft, organizing ability

entries.zh: 会动手做事；能活动、能运转
entries.en: to know how to do something; to be able to move and act
entries.notes: L 栏行间插注尾词残（Tiene fu…，疑 fuerza 类词），据汉字「運動」与音写 un tung 定义

entries.zh: 精通本业；手段高明、办法多
entries.en: to know one's office/trade well; to have skillful means
entries.notes: off° 缩写按 17 世纪通行用法推断为 oficio（行当/职事），且 M 栏含 T99 声调污损

entries.zh: 会谋生、能糊口度日；生计活计（生活，旧义指生计）
entries.en: to know how to earn one's living; livelihood

entries.zh: 知心腹；知道内情、看透心事
entries.en: to know what is within one's heart; to know inner thoughts and secrets

entries.zh: 知道得比它少；劣于此、不及于此
entries.en: to know less of it; to fall short of that

entries.zh: 败露；坏事败露、被人知晓
entries.en: to come to light, be exposed (of a bad deed)
entries.notes: 西语潦草（fere/consejo 难辨，照录所见），据汉字「敗露」与音写 pay lou 定义

entries.zh: 真知灼见；看得真切分明、确知
entries.en: to know/see it clearly and surely; true and certain perception

entries.zh: 无所不会（全会）；如天主般全知全能
entries.en: to know and be able to do everything, as God does; omniscient

entries.zh: 饱学、博学多闻；通晓所谈之事
entries.en: erudite, deeply learned; to know what is spoken of

entries.zh: 有涵养、学养深厚；极有学问
entries.en: cultivated and deeply learned; very erudite (doctissimo)

entries.zh: 大才；才华出众、极为博学
entries.en: great talent; most learned (doctissimo)
